title: Machine learning: its challenges and opportunities in plant system biology.
authors: Hesami, Mohsen; Alizadeh, Milad; Jones, Andrew Maxwell Phineas; Torkamaneh, Davoud
one_liner_zh: 综述机器学习在植物系统生物学多组学整合中的应用，涉及蛋白功能与蛋白-蛋白互作，但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Sequencing technologies are evolving at a rapid pace, enabling the generation of massive amounts of data in multiple dimensions (e.g., genomics, epigenomics, transcriptomic, metabolomics, proteomics, and single-cell omics) in plants. To provide comprehensive insights into the complexity of plant biological systems, it is important to integrate different omics datasets. Although recent advances in computational analytical pipelines have enabled efficient and high-quality exploration and exploitation of single omics data, the integration of multidimensional, heterogenous, and large datasets (i.e., multi-omics) remains a challenge. In this regard, machine learning (ML) offers promising approaches to integrate large datasets and to recognize fine-grained patterns and relationships. Nevertheless, they require rigorous optimizations to process multi-omics-derived datasets. In this review, we discuss the main concepts of machine learning as well as the key challenges and solutions related to the big data derived from plant system biology. We also provide in-depth insight into the principles of data integration using ML, as well as challenges and opportunities in different contexts including multi-omics, single-cell omics, protein function, and protein-protein interaction. KEY POINTS: * The key challenges and solutions related to the big data derived from plant system biology have been highlighted. * Different methods of data integration have been discussed. * Challenges and opportunities of the application of machine learning in plant system biology have been highlighted and discussed.
abstract_zh: 测序技术正以迅猛的速度发展，使得在植物中能够生成多维度的海量数据（例如，基因组学、表观基因组学、转录组学、代谢组学、蛋白质组学以及单细胞组学）。为了全面洞察植物生物系统的复杂性，整合不同的组学数据集至关重要。尽管计算分析流程的最新进展已能高效且高质量地探索和利用单一组学数据，但整合多维、异质且大规模的数据集（即多组学）仍是一个挑战。在这方面，机器学习（machine learning, ML）提供了有前景的方法来整合大型数据集并识别细粒度模式和关系。然而，这些方法需要严格的优化以处理源自多组学的数据集。在本综述中，我们讨论了机器学习的主要概念，以及与植物系统生物学衍生的大数据相关的关键挑战和解决方案。我们还深入探讨了使用机器学习进行数据整合的原理，以及在不同背景下（包括多组学、单细胞组学、蛋白质功能和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用）的挑战与机遇。要点：* 已强调与植物系统生物学衍生的大数据相关的关键挑战和解决方案。* 已讨论不同的数据整合方法。* 已强调并讨论了机器学习在植物系统生物学中应用的挑战与机遇。
